components.css: .ds-service-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 52px 1fr 42px;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:24px 0;border-top:1px solid #ccdbdf;border-bottom:1px solid #ccdbdf;border-radius:8px;color:#182a3b;text-decoration:none;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;transition:background 180ms ease,padding 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease}.ds-number{color:#526879;font-size:12px}.ds-mark{width:52px;height:52px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:14px;background:#dff6f2;color:#087f76}.ds-service-row strong{display:block;color:#10243a;font:750 20px Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-service-row small{display:block;margin-top:6px;color:#5f7080}.ds-arrow{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #aebfc4;border-radius:50%;transition:background 180ms ease,color 180ms ease}.ds-service-row:hover,.ds-service-row:focus-visible{padding-inline:16px;background:#fff;outline:3px solid #19b5a5;outline-offset:4px}.ds-service-row:hover .ds-arrow,.ds-service-row:focus-visible .ds-arrow{background:#10243a;color:#fff}.ds-service-row:active{transform:translateY(1px)}

narrative.overview: Coreserve should feel like a well-run property-services desk: composed, direct, and quietly capable. Deep navy creates authority, teal signals progress and availability, and pale technical surfaces keep long service information easy to scan. The system is modern without feeling like a generic technology product.
keyCharacteristics: Decisive navy first viewports with a single teal action colour.
Editorial service lists instead of interchangeable card grids.
Clear, high-contrast type and generous vertical rhythm.
Restrained motion that communicates coordination, never spectacle.

rules.name: The Teal Means Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve teal for action, status, and helpful emphasis; it should never become a large decorative wash.

rules.name: The One Statement Rule
rules.body: Each section earns one strong heading; avoid stacking uppercase eyebrow text above every heading.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow must explain layering or interactivity; section separation comes from tone, whitespace, or a fine line.

dos: Do preserve the navy, teal, pale blue-grey, and white colour relationship.
Do keep regulated service language factual and attribute work to appropriately qualified professionals.
Do use full-row interaction, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and persistent mobile affordances.
Do favour linear editorial lists and clear process steps for operational content.
donts: Don't add unverified accreditations, testimonials, logos, or performance claims.
Don't repeat uppercase eyebrow labels above every heading.
Don't use teal as a large decorative background or add unrelated accent colours.
Don't hide a service-row action on mobile or rotate readable text with decorative motion.
